system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I need to remove one passenger, Sophia, from my upcoming round trip flights from Las Vegas to Denver. The departure is May 19, return is May 20. Can you help me with this? I want the refund processed to my original payment method. And please, I don’t have my reservation ID handy right now—can you look it up with my name or user ID? My name is James Patel, user ID is james_patel_9828.

I already gave you my name (James Patel) and my user ID (james_patel_9828). Can you just look up my reservation and remove Sophia from the booking? I really need this done quickly. Also, how much will the refund be if I remove her? And again, I want the refund to go back to my original payment method.
